chunks: And from him, from Musa ibn 'Umar ibn Yazid,mar ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Sa'id al-Qammam, from whomever narrated to him, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'A virgin girl, with her parents' permission, invites me to herself privately; should I do that?' He said, 'Yes, and beware of the place of the private part.' I said, 'And if she is pleased with that?' He said, 'And if she is pleased with that, for it is a disgrace upon virgins.'

key_terms.مَوْضِعَ الْفَرْجِ: the place of the private part (genitals)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on having intercourse with a virgin girl if her parents allow it?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the permissibility of intercourse with a virgin whose parents grant permission, noting that her private invitation suffices for validity. However, he adds a nuanced scholarly distinction: even with her consent, the act is considered a 'disgrace' (‘ar) upon virgins, reflecting the Shia juristic view that virginity carries a specific social and moral prestige (istihsan) that is diminished by such unions, distinguishing it from mere legal validity (sahha).
